name: Simple Mart Retail Co., Ltd.
summary: Simple Mart Retail Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in managing supermarkets throughout Taiwan. Beyond its core operations, the company also retails a broad spectrum of goods, encompassing food items, beverages, and household essentials, in addition to offering home shopping services and organic product lines. Founded in 2003, Simple Mart Retail Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, and functions as a subsidiary of Mercuries & Associates Holding Ltd.
